exposure: Postpartum maternal serum concentration of orexin-A
postpartum maternal serum concentration of orexin-A
finding: Postpartum maternal serum orexin-A level was positively associated with postpartum marital satisfaction in women delivered through cesarean section.
mod_finding: The maternal orexin-A level of women delivered with cesarean section who had post-partum marital dissatisfaction was significantly lower than those one with marital satisfaction.
